# sonarqube_alm_bitbucket (Data Source)

Looks up a Bitbucket Server DevOps platform setting. Its secrets are not readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_alm_bitbucket" "main" {
  key = "bitbucket-server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `url` (String) Bitbucket Server URL.
